audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings tell the player 'you can't bait it away' about Realm of Death, which turns the level-6 phase into something with no counterplay.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100. A 140-second ultimate is the single most playable cooldown in the lane — surviving it once buys more than two minutes of free lane.
audit.corrected: Reframed from 'you cannot bait it' to 'survive it and own the next two minutes', with the number attached. Written into spikes[1], mid, whys[4] and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings call Hero's Entrance global and give it a taunt: 'win the map with a global 5-man knockup-and-taunt', 'Your value is the global', 'flag onto bot or mid for a 5-man knockup-and-taunt'.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 with range 4000/4750/5500, must land on an ALLY, and Riot's text is 'knocking up nearby enemies' plus a shield — there is no taunt on it. Shield of Durand is the only taunt in the kit.
audit.corrected: Restated as landing on an ally up to 4000 away for a multi-man knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible is called 'W shield-and-heal sustain' but nothing says where the shield comes from.
audit.why: Riot: 'Mordekaiser stores damage he DEALS AND TAKES to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.' Every point of chip Galio puts into him is banked and returned as healing, which makes idle poke actively counterproductive and makes the 12-second window, not the purchase, the anti-heal decision.
audit.corrected: Do not chip him between fights; bait Indestructible and commit inside its 12 seconds. Written into mid, whys[2], wants.foe[1], report[5] and report[8].

audit.whatIsWrong: The Obliterate isolation bonus is referenced twice but never turned into an instruction.
audit.why: Riot: 'Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.' Standing inside your own minion wave means his Q is not hitting a single enemy, so it lands soft; Death's Grasp exists to drag you out of that wave and is 16 seconds at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Stand in your wave to soften Obliterate, and treat a spent Death's Grasp as 16 seconds of safety. Written into early and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Realm of Death' repeats through the entry without a single number, and the resource asymmetry is never stated.
audit.why: Realm of Death 140/120/100, Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8, Obliterate 8/7/6/5/4, Indestructible 12/11/10/9/8. Mordekaiser's resource is Shield and every ability costs 0, while Galio's Q-W-E costs 60+50+50 = 160 mana at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, loading and early; the free-kit-versus-160-mana asymmetry stated in early and whys[2].

edits.before: His R, Realm of Death, yanks you into a 1v1 and steals a chunk of your stats — you can't bait it away, so the play is to survive it: hold W's magic damage reduction through his Q-E follow-up, then taunt on release once his combo is spent.
edits.after: His R, Realm of Death, yanks you into a 1v1 and steals a chunk of your stats — but it is 140 seconds at rank 1. Survive it once: hold Shield of Durand's reduction through his Q-E follow-up, taunt on release, and you own the next two minutes.

edits.before: His R, Realm of Death, drags you into an ally-free 1v1 and steals your stats — even holding Shield of Durand to survive it, the stat-steal swings this exact level his way.
edits.after: Realm of Death drags you into an ally-free 1v1 and steals your stats, and the level it arrives is his — but at 140 seconds, surviving it hands you the next window.

edits.before: This is the swing. His level 6 R drags you into an ally-free 1v1 and steals your stats, so respect it — you can't bait it away, but you can survive it: hold Shield of Durand through his Q-E follow-up so the amplified magic reduction eats his burst, then taunt on release and E-knockup once his combo is spent. With your first defensive item your shield turns his Q slam and W-empowered burst into a free kill, and your real spike here is Hero's Entrance — flag onto another lane while you trade even with him.
edits.after: This is the swing. His level 6 R drags you into an ally-free 1v1 and steals your stats, but it is 140 seconds at rank 1: survive it and the next two minutes are yours. Hold Shield of Durand through his Q-E follow-up so the amplified reduction eats the burst, then taunt on release and E-knockup once his combo is spent. Do not chip him between fights — Indestructible banks the damage he TAKES into a shield he consumes as a heal. Your spike is Hero's Entrance onto an ally 4000 units away.

edits.before: Morde owns the opening — his W shield and an isolated, empowered Q out-stat you before your kit is online, so don't let him E-pull you off the wave into his minions where Q's isolation bonus lands full. At level 1 you have one ability and no engage, so just last-hit at the lingering-tornado tip of Winds of War and concede the trade. Your turn comes at 3 once Q plus the W-taunt into E-knockup combo is up, but until then eat the poke and watch your mana — you can't taunt-combo on empty.
edits.after: Morde owns the opening — his W shield and an isolated, empowered Q out-stat you before your kit is online. Obliterate does MORE damage when it hits a single enemy, so stand inside your own minions and it lands soft; let him E-pull you off the wave and it lands full. At level 1 you have one ability and no engage, so last-hit at the lingering-tornado tip of Winds of War and concede the trade. Your turn comes at 3, but watch mana: your Q-W-E costs 160 and his whole kit costs nothing.

edits.after: Hero's Entrance is the decider — trade even in lane, then land on an ally 4000 away for a multi-man knockup while he shoves a sidewave.

Your value is the global: trade even in lane, then R into bot or mid for a 5-man knockup-and-taunt that wins you the map while he's stuck shoving a sidewave. Never solo-facecheck him into Realm of Death, and let Shield of Durand turn his teamfight commitment into your team's free kill.

edits.after: Your R, Hero's Entrance, is the lane-decider: trade even here while you land on an ally in bot or mid for a multi-man knockup, out-valuing a Morde who can only splitpush a sidelane.

edits.after: Mordekaiser wins by isolating you with Death's Grasp, banking your damage into Indestructible, and cashing the realm.

notes: Two things a player would act on wrongly. First, the entry says twice that Realm of Death 'can't be baited away', which reads as no counterplay — it is 140 seconds at rank 1, so surviving one is worth more than two minutes of lane, and that reframing is the single most useful change here. Second, Indestructible stores the damage Mordekaiser TAKES and lets him consume it as a heal, so the page's implicit advice to poke him down is feeding the shield; the anti-heal note existed but never explained the mechanic driving it. Also corrected three strings that call Hero's Entrance global and give it a taunt — it lands on an ally within 4000 and knocks up, and Shield of Durand is the only taunt Galio owns. FLAG MISFIRE noted, not written: the kit derives a grounding flag on Obliterate, which Riot's description (damage only, increased on a single target) does not support, so no claim about it denying dashes was made.
